notes.title: Update v1.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, its finally here. The biggest update to Project City yet and the first one of 2024. Sorry this one took so long but here is everything that has changed:

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Emails
[*] Added new Stocks
[*] Added Checks
[*] Added Tax
[*] Added Tax Evasion
[*] Added New Stocks & Stock Simulation
[*] Added New Quests
[*] Added New Factory Levels
[*] Added E-Commerce Store
[*] New Bank Management
[*] Added Credit Limit
[*] Added new Credit
[*] Added bank transaction history
[*] New Credit Score System
[*] Added new Credit payback option
[*] Added new Debt Agency
[*] Added Game Days & Hours
[*] Added Game Cycles
[*] Added Factory Level
[*] Added new Drug Cooking equipment
[*] Added 3 new sponsors to Tech Company
[*] 5 new Achievements
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character appearance
[*] New Reworked Stock Market
[*] Quests now save with save files
[*] New Quest System
[*] New Drug Cooking System
[*] New Reworked Factory
[*] New Reworked Bank Account & System
[*] New Reworked Credit System
[*] Modified Manufacture Cost System for Tech Company
[*] Nerfed Price per Product Rating in Tech Company
[*] Increased Sponsor Requirements in Tech Company
[*] Extended the Tech Company Manufacturing cooldown
[/list]
[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bank Cards & Credit Cards
[*] ATM
[*] Paying for Bank Account
[*] Drug Ingredients Quick Buy
[/list]

That is it for 1.4, I hope you enjoy this update and I'll see you all later.
Update 1.5 will be a smaller update so it should take around a month hopefully.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
First update to Project City is here. After launch, I realised a lot needed to be done to make the game way more enjoyable, this will take a few updates, so this is Stage 1 of my multi stage plan to make the game more fun. Here is what has changed:
[h3]Added[/h3]
- Added new Gun Business (legal and illegal)
- Added Post Office Robbery
- Added Restaurant & Cooking
- Added Chef Job (at restaurant)
- Added Crafter Job
- Added New Drugs (PCP, Heroin, Ecstasy, Fentanyl)
- Added Help Menu
- Added Law Enforcement Attention
- Added more Dumpsters
[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Reworked & New Technology Company
- Changed Dumpster Interactions
- Changed Apartment Default Rent
- Changed Arrest System
- Changed Lighting
- Made Loans a business, which needs to be purchased to get a loan.
- Reduced Prison times
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed Stock Market not Saving
- Fixed Factory Items not Saving
- Fixed Items going out of stock when performing split in vendors

That's it for this update, I'm going to take a break from full development of Project City for 1-2 weeks as I have been non stop developing since April. If there are bugs that arise, I will still post patches and bug fixes. After that, straight back to working on 1.2
Have a great day.

notes.title: Content Feature #1
notes.content:
Welcome to the first content feature. Here are a few features that will be available from Launch.

[h2]Businesses[/h2]
You can buy businesses such as Shops, Tech Shops, PC Shops, Factories ect. Once you buy the business, you will be able to manage it and make money from it. Once you save you will keep the business. Some businesses require active management such as inputting resources into it to keep it running, or active management. 
[h2]Gangs[/h2]
You can start a Gang if you buy it for $25,000. Once you bought the "business" you can name your gang and start managing it. You put money into the homebase balance which will allow you to hire gang members. With your hired gang members, you can send them to attack other gangs territories and take it for yourself, or you can send them to defend one of your territories (other gangs can attack your territory if it is doing well). You can sell drugs to your territory which is based on the "Drug Popularity" which will determine the chance of your drugs selling. Be careful, too much gang activity can get your gang busted by the DEA.
[h2]Drugs[/h2]
You can cook drugs and sell them either to your gang territories or to the Illegal Vendor. You will gain more money from selling to territory rather than selling to the illegal dealer. During random searches, if you have illegal items (drugs included) you will be sent to prison.
[h2]Credit & Loans[/h2]
If you are struggling with money, you can take a loan which you will have to pay back in 5 minute increments and in 5 instalments. If you fail to payback your loan, your businesses will be taken and your freedom will be taken (you will be sent to prison). 
You can use your Credit Card to take credit, which will amount the more money you spend on credit. You will then have to pay back your credit. If you don't pay it back within a given time frame, you will be jailed and your businesses will be taken. 
[h2]Hacking Studios[/h2]
You can buy a Hacking Studio where you use Personal Information Cards to hack victims bank accounts. You will need to input the right commands into the console in order to gain access, which means that there will be many obstacles to completion. 

That's it for now, stay tuned for more.
The Official Trailer is coming very soon, so stay tuned for that. (release date!)
Wishlist the game now on Steam.
